concerns.text: FR-005 and SC-003 require reporting Pearson r and ΔR² (4 decimal places). T017 (reporting r) and T017.1 (formatting ΔR²) are unchecked. While T051 computes r, the specific task to persist/format these values for the final report is missing or incomplete, leaving the success criteria unverified.

FR-012 requires computing static_connectivity_strength per participant. T014.1 (compute_static_connectivity_strength) and T014.2 (construct_covariates_dict) are unchecked. Without these, the regression model (T051) lacks the required covariate, violating FR-005.

FR-008 and SC-004 require diagnostic visualizations (residuals, QQ plots) and robustness to NaN. T023 (plot_residuals) and T058 (NaN handling) are unchecked. The system cannot generate the required `model_residuals.png` and `model_qq.png` without T023.

FR-006, FR-010, SC-002, and SC-005 require saving permutation results and sensitivity tables. T030 (save CSVs), T031 (verify columns), and T046.1 (construct DataFrame) are unchecked. The pipeline produces no output artifacts for these critical success criteria.

FR-009 requires logging all exclusion decisions. T020b (standardized logging invocation) is unchecked. While T018/T019 exist, the explicit task ensuring standardized reason codes are used is missing, creating a gap in the audit trail.
